API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the health metrics trend for a device
Gets the health metrics trend for a device
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/health-metrics

Gets the health metrics trend for a device. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours. The health metrics include CPU, Memory, Disk I/O, Network I/O, Wi-Fi, Network Bandwidth, etc.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
category
string

The category of the metrics.

instances
object[]
]
